s: who among the following from Guntur wrote series of articles in Hindu paper “On the present position of the Telugu people”
x:
Sitarama Shastri of Guntur wrote a series of influential articles titled "Telugu Prajala Prasthuta Paristhiti" in The Hindu newspaper. These articles analyzed the political, social and economic conditions of Telugu-speaking people and argued for administrative reforms and greater attention to regional interests. They significantly influenced public opinion during the Andhra movement.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
